title: Tray Icons settings window is closed when you open settings of one of its entries
line: Opening an entry's settings from the System Tray settings now keeps the System Tray settings open, with their unapplied changes.
explanation: Settings requests from applets inside the System Tray reach the panel, and PanelView kept a single applet settings window: opening a tray entry's settings deleted the open System Tray settings window and its unapplied changes. Applets configured through a KCM were unaffected because they open System Settings instead. PanelView now opens the settings of an applet nested inside the applet being configured in a second window, transient for the first; any other applet still replaces both, as before.

commits.message:
shell/panelview: open tray entry settings on top of the tray settings

Opening an entry's settings from the System Tray settings replaced that
window, so changes not yet applied were lost. Settings of an applet
inside the applet being configured now open in their own window on top.

BUG: 484710

media.caption: Before: System Tray settings with 'Always show all' ticked but not applied
Before: clicking Camera Indicator's settings button replaces the System Tray settings window
Before: after Cancel, the System Tray settings are gone and the change is lost
After: same start, 'Always show all' ticked, Apply enabled
After: Camera Indicator settings open as a separate window on top (moved aside to show both)
After: after Cancel, the System Tray settings are still open with the unapplied change

review.text: The approach is right: the single m_appletConfigView in PanelView is the real cause, and a second window for a nested applet, transient for the tray's window, keeps the unapplied changes. The screenshots and regression checks back this up. But only PanelView is changed, so a System Tray on the desktop (DesktopView has the same single-window logic) still loses its settings. The patch also no longer applies on master, because 2e07960365 removed the show() call in the re-activate branch.
changes: Apply the same nested-window handling in DesktopView::showConfigurationInterface. Ideally put the 'is this applet inside the configured one' check and the window handling in one shared helper, not two copies.
Rebase on origin/master, keeping 2e07960365's behaviour (no show() before requestActivate() when the window is already open).
